newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted easier on the U.S. unit but firmer on the rand and European currencies after a lacklustre Friday interbank session, dealers said.
"It didn't go anywhere today, it was pretty steady. Everyone was probably being cautious ahead of the weekend," commented one dealer.
Dealers said the central Reserve Bank came in to buy U.S. dollars off the market in the morning but this did move the exchange rates.
"I'm not sure whether they are trying to bring the Zimbabwe dollar down to 11.3100/3200," said one.
Earlier in the week, another dealer said the Reserve Bank seemed happier to see the local currency at those levels.
The Zimbabwe dollar finished the Friday at it's opening 11.3050/3150 against the U.S. dollar although this was weaker compared to Thursday's close of 11/3000/3100.
It however edged up on the rand to 2.5100/5300 from 2.5135/5175, on sterling to 18.4800/5000 from 18.4900/5120 and to 6.5400/5600 versus the mark from 6.5690/5775 the day before.
